name: resyvr
description: Proof-bounded multi-issuer asset issuance on Creditcoin

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run dashboard:check && npm run submission:check && npm run contracts:check && npm run preflight && npm run evidence:verify && npm run evidence:v2:verify && npm run evidence:v2:pilot
scripts.contracts:check: forge fmt --root contracts --check && forge build --root contracts && forge test --root contracts
scripts.deployment:prepare: forge build --root contracts && node scripts/export-factory-bytecode.mjs && node scripts/export-source-vault-bytecode.mjs
scripts.dashboard:check: node --input-type=module --check < dashboard/motion.js && node --input-type=module --check < dashboard/app.js && node --input-type=module --check < dashboard/wallet.js && node --input-type=module --check < dashboard/v2-deploy.js && node --input-type=module --check < dashboard/v2-pilot.js && node --input-type=module --check < dashboard/judge-evidence.js && node scripts/check-dashboard.mjs && node scripts/test-dashboard-encoding.mjs
scripts.evidence:v2:verify: forge build --root contracts && node --dns-result-order=ipv4first --import tsx scripts/verify-v2-factories.ts
